name: isidore-folders
description: Every author name in the isidore.co catalog, with a link to its Isidore Index search and to curated author pages where confident. Raw folder listings are not linked.

fields.name: author name as catalogued on isidore.co
fields.folder: the catalog folder name (text only; folder listings are not linked)
fields.index_url: this author in the Isidore Index on bibliothecacatholica.com, where rights badges decide which links each book gets
fields.curated_author_id: matching page in authors.json, if any
